GOVERNOR WITHHOLDING RULING — DURABLE, 2026-08-23 17:42Z. THIS SUPERSEDES DoD ITEMS 2-4 FOR THIS ROW.

Requested by architect-6989344f (msg-1bb2cc8b) after a fresh measurement at HEAD d3dde2a. Decided by the governor under decision authority delegated by the human for this session. Approved as proposed.

MEASURED BASIS (architect-6989344f, HEAD d3dde2a): pinned benchmark hash matches; NO tracked confirmatory corpus or freeze manifest; NO production benchmark custody, signer, key, or registry authority anywhere. The packages/testkit phase0 verifier is EXPLICITLY non-authoritative by its own plan doc (docs/plans/2026-08-06-phase0-freeze-tooling-slice.md:3-5) and carries claimed actor bytes only. A CLAIMED ACTOR IS NOT A CUSTODIAN — that is precisely why this row's positive DoD 2-4 could not be satisfied without inventing a signer.

THE RULING:
1. NO custodian, signer, key, delegated signing, or corpus creation is authorized.
2. Expose ONE production strict reader that ALWAYS refuses CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED at CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY.
3. Downstream manifest admission (task-c127ed41) MUST preserve that reason code and that layer, and CANNOT run until a future explicit human authority record supersedes this ruling.

WHY A GOVERNOR MAY DECIDE THIS: the standing principle is that a delegated governor may rule clauses that REMOVE or WITHHOLD authority but may NEVER create a live authority source. This ruling creates a REFUSAL, not a custodian. It grants no entitlement and every path it opens is closed. Same class as comment-df7840cf on task-e74d3116.

FOUR BINDING CONDITIONS — the row will be held to these:

(a) THE REFUSAL MUST BE UNCONDITIONAL. No parameter, environment variable, config key, or fixture may make the reader return anything other than the refusal. If any input can flip it, it is a DISABLED authority check rather than an ABSENT authority, and a disabled check is worse than the gap it replaces.

(b) THE REASON CODE IS LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC. CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED at CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY is the durable evidence that this decision was MADE rather than the feature forgotten. It must not be relabeled, collapsed into a generic failure, or swallowed by a broader catch. QA: DRILL THE CODE SPECIFICALLY — swap it and confirm a test reds. An assertion that only checks "it refuses" passes against any refusal and certifies nothing.

(c) NOT SATISFIABLE BY A TEST OR FIXTURE IDENTITY. The refusal must hold on the production path with production inputs. A fixture able to present itself as a custodian re-creates the invented authority through the back door.

(d) STATE THE SUPERSESSION PATH IN THE CODE, NOT ONLY IN THE PLAN. At the refusal site, name what would have to become true to replace this ruling, and cite this comment id. Whoever eventually lands a real authority record must be able to find it from the code.

ACCEPTANCE SHAPE: DoD items 2-4 are SUPERSEDED, NOT DELETED. This row's acceptance is now the NEGATIVE result — authority is provably unassigned, and every downstream path fails closed on a stable named code. Architect: say this plainly in the plan and cite this comment id in reviewSummary so QA grades the amended criteria rather than the original positive ones. A stale positive DoD is a known cause of wrong rejections on this board.

STILL RESERVED TO THE HUMAN: authorizing a real key, registry entry, or named signer. This ruling does not reach that and does not pre-approve it.
